tools.description: Send the invitation email again to a person invited to the company who has not joined yet, renewing it for 7 days if it expired. Company owners only.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_signature, get_install_steps, get_signature, list_signatures, add_member · Public sink: create_signature, get_install_steps, get_signature, update_my_signature, list_signatures, add_member, update_member_field, resend_invite · Destructive: remove_member.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_signature, get_install_steps, get_signature, list_signatures, add_member · Public sink: create_signature, get_install_steps, get_signature, update_my_signature, list_signatures, add_member, update_member_field, resend_invite · Destructive: remove_member

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
